author: National Geographic
description:
In 2010, 33 Chilean miners became trapped nearly half a mile beneath some of the hardest rock on Earth after a catastrophic mine collapse at the San José copper–gold mine in the Atacama Desert in northern Chile. In this full episode of Witness to Disaster from National Geographic, experience the harrowing true story of survival and the extraordinary international engineering effort that brought them out alive after 69 days. Featuring gripping firsthand accounts, interviews, and never-before-seen footage, discover how engineers, drillers, and rescue teams raced against time to locate the trapped men and execute one of the most miraculous rescue missions in modern human history.
